conflicts.description: Four equal phases with two holds (BHF, NHS SFH, Cleveland) vs three-phase 'square' inhale-hold-exhale with no post-exhale hold (Newcastle Hospitals NHS). Labels box/square are not a reliable kernel.

Landscape mechanism_shape treats pauses as family identity. Named Iyengar chapter is unread; secondary reports that beginner equal inhale/exhale omits holds must not be ingested from wiki. Do not rewrite landscape kernel in this pass.
Count of 4 is a common health-education default, not shown to be the family kernel. Iyengar (unread) is reported to use other counts. Product probe uses 4; that is an expression hypothesis.
Consumer pages equate box breathing with Navy SEAL tactical breathing and with sama vritti. Shortlist keeps those identities separate. Packaging is not a source.

families.selection_summary: Three selected loci, different jobs: BHF = four-phase kernel; NHS SFH = four-phase kernel plus stop-rules; Newcastle = three-phase conflict locus. Supporting loci must not be averaged into that kernel. Type box_breathing remains unattested. Technique canon stays empty.
